name: Ahab
overview: The biblical figure Ahab, king of Israel, is portrayed as a leader whose reign was marked by idolatry and wickedness, leading to severe divine judgment. Scripture highlights that the 'works of the house of Ahab' and the statutes of Omri brought desolation upon the people, as noted in Micah 6:16. Furthermore, Jeremiah 29 condemns false prophecy associated with Ahab's lineage, pronouncing that those who prophesy lies in God's name will face judgment, even referencing Ahab as an example of one who suffered God's fiery wrath. These passages collectively emphasize the consequences of rebellion against God's statutes and the importance of faithfulness to Him.
